checks.label: dev-travel
checks.runtime: actual Next /dev route and production scene components

browserChecksDetails.name: Hidden /dev route opens directly with noindex and a complete destination catalogue
Category and accent-insensitive search filter actual destination buttons
Keyboard launch opens the real personal deck, movement works, and reset restores the starting point
Changing equipment in the test armory stays in memory and returning preserves the personal deck
All seven Clan Ship room arrivals mount the real interior and their authored scenery
Approach, docking and boarding use the real Clan Ship transitions within the test session
Homeworld port and market open at distinct real city positions, and city movement works
A regional destination opens its live village, and F8 returns to the catalogue even from its modal
All nine Wolf castle arrivals render their real rooms, accept movement and reset the disposable visit
Wolf approach, boarding, settings and departure use native actions, and F8 escapes its real map
All eight arrival entries preload their native resources and identify the correct mission, planet, hunter and ship
Arrival pause, mobile controls, reload, reset and native Skip preserve the campaign and enter one real hunt
A full natural arrival presents all eight shots and hands the same mission to one real hunt without storage writes
A real mission keeps its position and clock after walking into a newly discovered room
Direct bookmarked room URLs and reload recreate a disposable session
Unknown destination is recoverable through the catalogue
Mobile catalogue and Clan Ship support touch at 390 px without horizontal overflow
An empty browser can visit and reset a real room without creating any save or database
Leaving development returns to the ordinary game menu with no developer navigation entry
Visited development scenes produce no missing asset, uncaught JavaScript exception or storage write

checks.scope: Direct travel, real movement and mission startup, Wolf castle rooms and approach, eight planetary arrivals with natural and skipped handoffs, reset, URL entry, keyboard and touch, and campaign storage isolation. No complete campaign, art approval or performance qualification.

browserChecksDetails.name: Main menu resumes the existing campaign on the personal deck
The orbital castle remains separate from the personal hull and Clan Ship
Walking reaches the airlock, vestibule, gallery and real archive terminal
Castle room and personal hull survive menu, reload and Continue
The audience and council preserve one campaign decision
The three-seal court trial is traversed and completed without campaign rewards
The royal court starts a real three-guard fight with damage and a saved exact position
A paused fight survives menu and reload without recovering health or resetting the guard
A real browser tab change pauses the fight and returning never resumes it implicitly
Taking the announced hits ends in defeat, then restart creates one fresh attempt
Combat controls fit 320 pixels and abandoning unlocks the same court safely
Ordinary keyboard movement, timed parries, dodges and attacks defeat the three guards
Castle navigation and return remain usable at 390 and 320 pixels
The accepted audience grants a new mandate whose objectives require fresh station interactions
A partially explored mandate survives Save, menu, reload and Continue with the same training dossier
The gallery and council complete the three objectives and unlock the separate sentinel encounter
The paused mandate reloads the same sentinel, damaged health, position and elapsed time before explicit resume
Real movement, parries, dodges and attacks beat all sentinel phases without healing or an early reward
The return guide reaches the audience and a refused reward write keeps the victory and balance unclaimed
Retrying the same audience action commits exactly two marks together with the campaign receipt
The completed mandate keeps one receipt and one reward after reload, another audience consultation and departure
A campaign launch freezes a single run, destination, ship and hunter before any hunt mounts
A real browser tab change suspends arrival and preserves the same mission on return
Arrival pause freezes active time and reduced-motion keeps the same mission
Arrival menu, reload and Continue retain the same run without a gameplay sidecar
A refused handoff leaves the hunt unmounted and can retry the same run once
Reload after handoff resumes the real hunt and never replays arrival
A second isolated campaign launches the full moving arrival
The title, actual carrier and separate capsule are presented before the descent
Descent reload retains mission and run, then explicitly resumes the same shot
Atmosphere, ground impact and the selected hunter lead to exactly one natural handoff
The complete route has no browser exception and every requested visual is available

limitations: Bounded browser automation; no whole-campaign, performance or complete visual approval.
Wolf records uncaught page errors but does not expose a consoleErrors collection.
Only /dev provides per-source-file hashes and per-capture hashes; all ZIP bytes for both artifacts match GitHub's digest.
Wolf artifact name uses github.sha (PR merge ref); the checkout and reported runtime both use the exact PR head.
